record.bible_text: And I said<WH0559><WTH8799>, Hear<WH08085><WTH8798>, I pray you, O heads<WH07218> of Jacob<WH03290>, and ye princes<WH07101> of the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>; <FI>Is it<Fi> not for you to know<WH03045><WTH8800> judgment<WH04941>?

Who hate<WH08130><WTH8802> the good<WH02896>, and love<WH0157><WTH8802> the evil<WH07451>; who pluck off<WH01497><WTH8802> their skin<WH05785> from off them, and their flesh<WH07607> from off their bones<WH06106>;

Who also eat<WH0398><WTH8804> the flesh<WH07607> of my people<WH05971>, and flay<WH06584><WTH8689> their skin<WH05785> from off them; and they break<WH06476><WTH8765> their bones<WH06106>, and chop them in pieces<WH06566><WTH8804>, as for the pot<WH05518>, and as flesh<WH01320> within<WH08432> the caldron<WH07037>.

Then shall they cry<WH02199><WTH8799> unto the LORD<WH03068>, but he will not hear<WH06030><WTH8799> them: he will even hide<WH05641><WTH8686> his face<WH06440> from them at that time<WH06256>, as they have behaved themselves ill<WH07489><WTH8689> in their doings<WH04611>.

Thus saith<WH0559><WTH8804> the LORD<WH03068> concerning the prophets<WH05030> that make my people<WH05971> err<WH08582><WTH8688>, that bite<WH05391><WTH8802> with their teeth<WH08127>, and cry<WH07121><WTH8804>, Peace<WH07965>; and he that putteth<WH05414><WTH8799> not into their mouths<WH06310>, they even prepare<WH06942><WTH8765> war<WH04421> against him.

Therefore night<WH03915> <FI>shall be<Fi> unto you, that ye shall not have a vision<WH02377>; and it shall be dark<WH02821><WTH8675><WH02821><WTH8804> unto you, that ye shall not divine<WH07080><WTH8800>; and the sun<WH08121> shall go down<WH0935><WTH8804> over the prophets<WH05030>, and the day<WH03117> shall be dark<WH06937><WTH8804> over them. <RF>that...: vision: Heb. from a vision<Rf> <RF>that...: divine: Heb. from divining<Rf>

Then shall the seers<WH02374> be ashamed<WH0954><WTH8804>, and the diviners<WH07080><WTH8802> confounded<WH02659><WTH8804>: yea, they shall all cover<WH05844><WTH8804> their lips<WH08222>; for <FI>there is<Fi>  no answer<WH04617> of God<WH0430>. <RF>lips: Heb. upper lip<Rf><CM>

But truly<WH0199> I am full<WH04390><WTH8804> of power<WH03581> by the spirit<WH07307> of the LORD<WH03068>, and of judgment<WH04941>, and of might<WH01369>, to declare<WH05046><WTH8687> unto Jacob<WH03290> his transgression<WH06588>, and to Israel<WH03478> his sin<WH02403>.

Hear<WH08085><WTH8798> this, I pray you, ye heads<WH07218> of the house<WH01004> of Jacob<WH03290>, and princes<WH07101> of the house<WH01004> of Israel<WH03478>, that abhor<WH08581><WTH8764> judgment<WH04941>, and pervert<WH06140><WTH8762> all equity<WH03477>.
They build up<WH01129><WTH8802> Zion<WH06726> with blood<WH01818>, and Jerusalem<WH03389> with iniquity<WH05766>. <RF>blood: Heb. bloods<Rf>

The heads<WH07218> thereof judge<WH08199><WTH8799> for reward<WH07810>, and the priests<WH03548> thereof teach<WH03384><WTH8686> for hire<WH04242>, and the prophets<WH05030> thereof divine<WH07080><WTH8799> for money<WH03701>: yet will they lean<WH08172><WTH8735> upon the LORD<WH03068>, and say<WH0559><WTH8800>, <FI>Is<Fi> not the LORD<WH03068> among<WH07130> us? none evil<WH07451> can come<WH0935><WTH8799> upon us. <RF>and say: Heb. saying<Rf>

Therefore shall Zion<WH06726> for your sake<WH01558> be plowed<WH02790><WTH8735> <FI>as<Fi> a field<WH07704>, and Jerusalem<WH03389> shall become heaps<WH05856>, and the mountain<WH02022> of the house<WH01004> as the high places<WH01116> of the forest<WH03293>.<CM>
